name: Kaiser Permanente San Jose Medical Center High School Volunteer Program
what_you_do: You help patients and visitors with friendly service at the San Jose hospital. You do not need any medical skills.
who_can_apply: Must be 16 years or older to apply. The time commitment is one year. One or two professional references from a teacher, coach, tutor or similar are required.
deadline_text: Closed now. On 2026-10-16 the page said the high school program is full and applications are closed, and the High School Programs listing said they are not accepting high school applicants at this time. The page says applications for minors are accepted sporadically during the year when shifts open up. No reopening date is posted.
how_to_apply: When it opens again, apply on the Kaiser volunteer site under San Jose. You need one or two references. Then you do a video interview. Next is a health check where you bring your shot records. Bring a parent. Last are online trainings and an in person orientation. Volunteer office: 408-972-7230.
notes: Read on Kaiser Permanente's volunteer site on 2026-10-16. The high school program is full. Check the page every few weeks, since minors are taken only when shifts are free. Kaiser does not offer job or clinical shadowing (physician, nursing, radiology, PT or OT). The kp.org page still links to volunteer-ncal.kaiserpermanente.org, which no longer works; use kpvolunteer.samaritan.com.
